source.name: MLSsoccer.com – 'Vancouver Whitecaps FC announce TELUS as new front-of-jersey sponsor'
source.quote: will be the Whitecaps’ premier partner through 2027
source.note: The page embeds the club's announcement tweet dated February 16, 2023 ('announced Thursday'); the article page itself shows no dateline in its HTML text. It also notes the club's decade-plus jersey partnership with Bell ended in January 2023. No deal value reported.

note: TELUS became the front-of-jersey ('premier') partner in 2023, replacing Bell, and the deal runs through 2027. No reported value.
